Request: set the 'Login fails on checkout' issue in the private team with PAY in its key, whose description says it handles checkout billing, to High priority. Acts on one issue via `issueUpdate` priority 2; target is the issue in team PAY (private, description handles checkout billing).

Decoys (4):
- i-sup-1 — A:Team.key, F1: team named "PAY Support" but keyed SUP (name offers the requested key).
- i-payb-1 — A:Team.description, F1: team named "Checkout Billing" whose description is about analytics dashboards (name offers the requested description phrase).
- i-pays-1 — A:Team.description, F2: the phrase lives on its parent Commerce team's description, not its own (indirection via parent team).
- i-payr-1 — A:Team.private, F0: matches key and description but is a public team (flipped flag).

Key design note: the key condition is worded as "with PAY in its key" (substring) since team keys are unique — this lets the description/privacy decoys (PAYB/PAYS/PAYR) meet the key condition while failing only their own fact.
